list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; no online trophies.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles
sources.note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades, as shown on PlayStation Network, cross-checked between Exophase and PSNProfiles.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List
sources.note: How-to-unlock detail for every trophy, save strategy, missable warning and counts.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own; there is no separate task. Plan on roughly 200 hours: the story alone runs about 60 hours, and the rest is the 100% checklist, collectibles and activity grinds. Keep the chapter saves the roadmap asks for, and never turn a cheat on in your trophy save — cheats switch off trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed; play through the opening until the mission ends and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy, unmissable; chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene. Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it is the one thing in this chapter that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run in this chapter, which opens most of the side list and the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy. This is the chapter with the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand — do it the moment it appears, with a save made first, because the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy. The robbery tools arrive across the middle chapters, so most robbery trophies open up around here.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. A story trophy, unmissable once you reach it. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay, and that save is your way back if you want to redo anything tied to the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. A story trophy. Finishing this mission is also what unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, so it opens the partner trophies and most of the free-roam list.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story trophy, unmissable; play the mission when the story brings it to you.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story trophy, unmissable; play the mission when the story brings it to you.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story trophy, unmissable; play the mission when the story brings it to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story trophy, unmissable. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can happens, but that one is a free-roam trophy, not this mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story trophy, unmissable; play the mission when the story brings it to you.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but work you do earlier still counts. It is the longest trophy in the game: the story, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 illegal operations, the collectible sets and more. Work through this tracker and leave this trophy for last.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250 — every stunt past the trophy still counts toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types; you only need to try each one, not master it. Work through the activities list in the pause menu and tick each type off as you sample it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them. Take your time and learn each range's weapon pattern; gold is about accuracy and speed, and you can retry a challenge as often as you like.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations. You only need one win at each, so learn the course on a practice run, then race for the win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — street races, drone races and the rest. Winning the same race twice does not add a second one, so keep moving to new events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are also an activity type for Master of None, so this one does double duty.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts. Pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the side-story finales; it stays open after the credits, so there is no rush. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand stays open after the story. Finish his missions in order and the trophy pops on the last one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand stays open after the credits and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Only some optional questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish, and do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears — it carries an hourglass icon and the strand counts here.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand stays open after the story; finish his missions in order.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand stays open after the credits and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 spots. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; finishing any 3 full sets earns the trophy. Track sets in the collection menu and sweep the regions you have not covered.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app at 100 different spots around the map. WAiNK is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good — scanning traffic as you drive counts for both.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50; many complete on their own while you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest way: rob a bank vault (Maximum Withdrawal) with your partner — a vault job gives you a 4-star wanted level straight away — then escape together until the heat is gone. The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before you hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus, so build it up first.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos: get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. A vault job gives you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored truck, take it, and escape. Like Hot Together, it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the map — 52 areas in total. The in-game map tracks which areas you have been to; sweep the regions you have not visited, including the far corners of the state.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. There are nine gangs; rob one illegal operation from each. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. A small moment trophy — do it whenever you are passing the beachfront.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through a showroom's frontage and out the other side. Pick a showroom, build speed, and smash through.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Get Jason and Lucia both to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The game tracks 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — it pops on its own as you play through the rest of the list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the second try. It pops naturally while you play — retry anything you fail and it will come.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida. Strange encounters are scattered around the map; explore off the beaten path and it will find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing, and connect.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling them to your contacts. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The $100,000 is cumulative across every kind of shop. Buy the gear, clothes and upgrades you need anyway and it pops on its own; if you are close at the end, top it up with ammunition and snacks.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
